dog.description_text:
Hi! My name is Reacher AKA Rue to my foster daddy and I just arrived to NYC!

I am so calm and I am so sweet.
I am good with cats and people!

I’m very calm and I want to just lay down whenever possible. Pet me all you want, I’m not offended. I don’t really make any noise either!

I am fearful and very scared of loud noises behind me and fast moving objects so the city is hard for me but with some confidence I think I’ll get used to it.

I can’t wait to settle in and start enjoying treats and learning some commands.

The city is big and scary through my soulful angel eyes but I’m excited for this new adventure.
dog.name: Reacher
